label: Subtraction with an adder
subgoals: Invert every bit of the subtrahend
Add with a carry-in of one
Reduce the result modulo two to the n

label: Unsigned comparison from the carry-out
subgoals: Compute a plus the inverted b plus one as an ordinary integer
Set the carry-out when the sum reaches two to the n
Read carry-out one as a greater than or equal to b

label: Signed comparison from N and V
section: Signed comparison from N and V
subgoals: Compute the sign bit of the wrapped difference
Compute the signed-overflow flag of the subtraction
XOR the two flags to decide a less than b
